summary: Give the QA provider compact local evidence/region aliases and expand one base-plus-many-percentages operation into canonical calculations.
decision_refs: The second frozen Flash rerun improved contract-valid outcomes from 6 of 15 to 10 of 15 with no automatic retry
Three of the five remaining failures were citation-scope failures after quote copying had already been removed
Opaque random evidence IDs carry no model-relevant meaning and can be deterministically mapped from bounded input order
approval_evidence: The user explicitly requested continued implementation, testing and iteration.
known_limitations: Compact aliases reduce transcription errors but do not prove evidence relevance or answer completeness.
Percentage expansion remains limited to one cited base and cited percentage operands and never performs unit or date conversion.
The provider can still select the wrong in-scope alias; all numeric, entity and source checks remain authoritative.
No third live provider run is included in this implementation change.
